title: Collector not receiving data
symptom: The user reports that xDrip connects to the Bubble reader for a Libre sensor, but the 'Collecting Initial Readings' never passes the 'Data Collector Running' stage, with an hourglass icon before 'Receiving Data from Bubble Collector'. Data packets are sent but have checksum errors.
cause: The issue is a bug in the xDrip code supporting the Bubble transmitter, related to checksum calculation, as stated by a maintainer. The Bubble dev team is needed to fix it.
evidence_quote: It is a bug in the xDrip code supporting the bubble transmitter and has nothing to do with the removal of the Diabox app from Play Store. But only the @bubbledevteam can fix it. It looks like it is related to the checksum calculation.
